scope: Cancellation fixture isolation plus exactly one production startup-before-first-turn cancellation sentinel branch, reusing the existing strict durable Stop binding gate.
behavior: Await asynchronous onSession registration and revocation before exposing readiness/completion.
Synchronously own default/startup gates; release existing and late gates during closing.
Immediately observe and join original test-body, execution, and Stop promises; Vitest and assertions still receive original promises.
Restore owned environment/temp root only after body and children have quiesced.
A cleanup failure/deadline latches immediate rejection before later mock resets; a single afterAll bounded cleanup retry does not clear the failure.
Preserve original 66 assertions and four waitFor calls; add strict startup cancellation outcomes/no-failure-write assertions plus eight invalid-durable-intent cases. Original test budgets unchanged.
Startup Stop API and execution readers share actual committed mock writes through a getter, preserving pending/ACK semantics without actor-flag or ACK fabrication.

Use native_session_cancelled only after a startup Stop prevented the first turn. Existing schema/company/run/issue/scope/nonempty audit/state guard determines cancellation recovery; generic missing-result handling is unchanged.
isolation: Equivalent official NODE_ENV=test and fresh canonical PAPERCLIP_HOME/PAPERCLIP_CONFIG/INSTANCE_ID/TMPDIR, inherited test-host-home contract; absolute synthetic jq fixture. No environment secret key bypass.
diagnosticContract: Expected injected failures remain failures. Assertion seam precedes readiness; timeout seam awaits real backend admission then pauses before original body try/finally. Only transform diagnostic sets selected matrix-case timeout to 1000ms; shared file budgets remain unchanged. The four transform diagnostics have 679 name-filtered pending items; startup-only runs filter the other 675 cases. These are not platform skips.
discovery: The first complete 681 run produced 675 pass/6 fail after strict assertions revealed previously swallowed TypeError. A subsequent transaction-shape diagnostic exposed db.delete rather than fixing semantics. With actual shared Stop writes, all six old-production cases deterministically wrote failed status despite bound pending/ACK. The narrow production sentinel change fixes that contract; invalid intent cases retain ordinary failure.
limits: The original official first readiness wait failure cause remains unknown. These deterministic baselines prove a fixture leak/cascade mechanism and its closure, not the trigger of that original first failure.
Input snapshots cover listed code/config/fixture scope, not every transitive installed binary or generated artifact.
Old diagnostic code is intentionally abandoned in an isolated worker; no broad process termination or unproven temp-directory deletion is used.
crossReview: code_review independently read both versions of the owner patch; no lifecycle gap found after startup gate/Stop/body registration and strict outcome assertions.
